description: JSON schema for a suggestion query.

searchTerm.description: The free text search terms. The suggestion will be provided for these terms.

maxEdit.description: The maximum number of single-character edits (insertions, deletions, or substitutions) allowed between the input query and a suggested term. Must be 1 or 2. Default is 2.

size.description: The maximum number of suggestions to return for each term in the input text. The default is 5.

sort.name: SuggestedTermSort
sort.description: Specifies how suggestions should be sorted in the response.

enum.name: SCORE
enum.description: Sort by similarity score, then document frequency, and then the term itself.

enum.name: FREQUENCY
enum.description: Sort by document frequency, then similarity score, and then the term itself.
